answer: The marble counter is kept in vertex and zephyr publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2806 identities would post 3310 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
